omnisystem.omniccPath.markdownDescription: Path to the OmniCC compiler executable. Defaults to `omnicc` on PATH. Set an absolute path if omnicc is not globally available.

omnisystem.bootstrapPath.markdownDescription: Path to the OmniCC bootstrap launcher (`bootstrap/omnicc.mjs`). Leave empty to auto-detect under the workspace root. Used by **Run Titan File (Bootstrap Runtime)**, which executes `.titan` files with the Node-hosted seed interpreter (no external toolchain needed).

omnisystem.lspServerPath.markdownDescription: Path to the compiled Omnisystem LSP server binary. Leave empty to auto-detect from `omniccPath` sibling directory.

omnisystem.buildTarget.description: Default compilation target triple for OmniCC.

enumDescriptions: No optimization — fastest compile, best for debugging
Full optimization — slowest compile, best runtime performance
Size optimization — minimize output binary size

omnisystem.enableLsp.description: Enable the Omnisystem Language Server for diagnostics, completions, hover info, and go-to-definition.

omnisystem.enableInlayHints.description: Show inlay hints for type annotations, parameter names, and return types.

omnisystem.enableAxiomVerification.description: Enable background AXIOM formal verification. When enabled, proofs and theorems are checked incrementally on save.

omnisystem.enableSylvaInference.description: Enable SYLVA shape/type inference for ML model files. Shows tensor shapes and inferred types as inlay hints.

omnisystem.omnipmRegistryUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the OmniPM package registry. Defaults to the official Omnisystem registry.

omnisystem.desktopPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Omnisystem Ecosystem root directory. Used to locate the Omnisystem Launcher, Buddy, and Browser Extension source trees.

omnisystem.omniOsPlatform.description: Target OS platform for OmniOS builds.

omnisystem.parallelCompilation.description: Enable parallel compilation. Uses multiple CPU cores to compile independent translation units simultaneously.

omnisystem.maxParallelJobs.description: Maximum number of parallel compile jobs. Effective only when parallelCompilation is enabled.

omnisystem.showBuildDashboard.description: Automatically open the Build Dashboard panel when a build starts.

omnisystem.enableSemanticTokens.description: Enable semantic syntax highlighting via the LSP semantic tokens API. Requires enableLsp to be true.

omnisystem.lspTraceLevel.description: LSP protocol trace level for debugging language server communication.

omnisystem.buildOnSave.description: Automatically trigger an incremental build when a source file is saved.

omnisystem.formatOnSave.description: Automatically format source files with omnicc fmt on save.

omnisystem.showWelcome.description: Show the Welcome Screen on first install. Set to false to disable.

omnisystem.harness.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the OmniHarness orchestrator (FastAPI). The AI panel routes all model calls through this gateway.

omnisystem.harness.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Default model id used by the OmniHarness AI panel. Format: `provider/model` (e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`, `gpt-4o`, `ollama/llama3.2`).

enumDescriptions: Ask before every file write, edit, or command
Auto-approve read-only tools; still prompt for writes and commands
Never prompt — auto-approve all tool actions (use with caution)
omnisystem.harness.approvalMode.description: How the AI agent asks permission before acting on your project.

enumDescriptions: Use native function calling when the model supports it; fall back to the text protocol otherwise
Always use native function calling (best for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq, Mistral)
Always use the universal text-based tool protocol (works with any model, including small local ones)
omnisystem.harness.toolMode.description: How the AI agent invokes tools: native provider function-calling, or a universal text protocol.

omnisystem.harness.orchestratorPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the OmniHarness folder (the one containing `orchestrator/`). Leave empty to auto-detect in the workspace.

omnisystem.harness.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used to launch the OmniHarness orchestrator (`python -m uvicorn ...`).

omnisystem.harness.autoStartServer.description: Automatically start the OmniHarness orchestrator when the AI panel opens (if it is not already running). On by default so the server is fully self-managing — you should never need to start it manually.

omnisystem.harness.autoInstallDependenci.description: Automatically install missing OmniHarness orchestrator Python dependencies (pip install -e .) before starting it.

omnisystem.harness.autoRestartServer.description: Automatically restart the OmniHarness orchestrator (with backoff) if it crashes unexpectedly. Does not apply after a manual Stop Server.

omnisystem.harness.autoCompact.description: Automatically summarize older conversation turns once the live context approaches the model's context window, instead of silently truncating them.

omnisystem.harness.compactThreshold.description: Fraction of a model's context window that triggers auto-compaction of older turns.

program.description: Path to the TITAN/Omnisystem source file or BUILD.omnisystem to launch.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the running program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the launched program.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause execution at program entry point.

target.description: Build target triple (e.g. x86_64-linux). Overrides omnisystem.buildTarget for this launch.

omniccPath.description: Override path to the OmniCC compiler for this debug session.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the launched program.

optimizationLevel.description: Compiler optimization level for this debug session.

pid.description: Process ID of the running Omnisystem program to attach to.

cwd.description: Working directory of the target process.

configurationSnippets.description: Attach the debugger to a running Omnisystem process.

target.description: Compilation target triple (e.g. x86_64-linux, wasm32). Overrides workspace default.

files.description: Specific source files to compile. If empty, compiles the whole project.

extraArgs.description: Additional arguments passed verbatim to omnicc.

optimizationLevel.description: Override optimization level for this task.
